content.title: Royale Energy Restructures Capital for Growth Opportunities
content.summary: Royale Energy ( (ROYL) ) has shared an update. Royale Energy Inc. successfully executed strategic financial transactions to simplify its capital structure by exchanging Series B Preferred Stock for common stock, stock options, and unsecured promissory notes. This effort resolved over $24 million in liquidation preferences and $3 million of liabilities, aligning stakeholder interests with the company’s growth strategy.
